reason: The measurements reproduce exactly (1440: sheet 1322->916, lanes 280->196, card 256->172, note 202->118, the same four titles trimmed, and 'Menu tasting' losing 'before service notes are locked'), but the diagnosis inverts the paid lesson: 196 IS the declared floor (src/tasks.css:633 `--lane: minmax(196px, 372px)`), applied deliberately with the drawer open and recorded there, not an undocumented collapse to 105px — and 'Panels that open must not delete columns' is honoured as shipped (Done shows 180px of itself, board overflow 32px with the snap already on .tray) while the proposed fix violates it. Driven with the rule in place before render at 1440-planning, `repeat(5, minmax(258px,1fr))` puts Done 132px PAST the board's right edge (doneShown -132, overflow 406px), failing the standing assertion 'planning open @1440 · Done is still on the board, not deleted by the drawer' by 228px, and because data-head="stack" is stamped at sheet<1200 it also breaks 'five lanes fit with nothing sliced' for the drawer-SHUT board at 1180 (260px over) and 1280 (160px over). Sweeping the floor with a forced retrim shows there is no value that satisfies both constraints: 196 -> 4 titles trimmed / Done 180px shown; 216 -> 2 trimmed / Done 36px (already under the gate's 96px bar); 234 -> 0 trimmed / Done -36px; 258 -> 0 trimmed / Done -132px. 196 is the only rung on that ladder that keeps the fifth lane on the sheet, and the trims it costs are word-safe, carry the full string on data-full and in aria-describedby, and the card opens in place to read the note in full.
sharpenedFix: Nothing to ship in the layout; one line of prose to correct. The comment at src/tasks.css:627-628 asserts 'A card holds its type down to 196 — the title takes a second line, nothing clips', and that is measurably false at drawer-open: four of thirteen titles and one note are trimmed at 196. Rewrite it to state the trade the founder actually made — at 196 four titles and one note take a word-safe trim so that Done stays 180px on the sheet, and every wider floor deletes Done instead — so the next reader does not re-open this as a bug. If the trim count is to be held, add it to interaction-check.mjs as a budget ('planning open @1440 · no more than four card titles trim, and Done keeps 96px') rather than moving the floor.
